strict.label: Only this material
strict.help: Slides the material does not cover are flagged instead of being written from general knowledge.

blended.label: Fill the gaps
blended.help: Where the material is thin, the AI adds its own explanation to keep the course complete.

replicate.label: Follow the book
replicate.help: Keeps the material's own section headings, numbering and order, and preserves stated chapter identity (number, title, authors, objectives).

adapt.label: Adapt for teaching
adapt.help: The AI may re-title and re-order sections to make the course flow better.

full.label: Every section
full.help: Every selected section becomes at least one slide, so nothing in the material is skipped. Makes longer courses.

highlights.label: Highlights
highlights.help: Closely-related sections may be condensed into fewer slides.

noTopicsYet: This knowledge base has no topics yet, so the whole of it will be used.
everySlideFromPages: Every slide will be written from the pages about its own topic, and will show which page it came from.
